text:
sam: quick sync 1: thinking of moving the live preview into a bottom dock (sticky) so you can scroll rules while watching results. thoughts?

tess: dock is great for iteration but we lose vertical space on laptops. make it collapsible and remember per-user preference? :thinking_face:

leo: agree. default dock for >=1366px, modal on small screens. add a density toggle (condensed/comfortable).

amira: copy nit: "Priority 1" badges are bulky. show just the number visually and use aria-label="priority 1" for screen readers.

sam: perfect 1: keeps scan density up.

tess: a11y note: yellow warning chip fails contrast at 14px. will file ticket to darken or add a 1px border.

leo: keyboard reorder: Alt+ArrowUp/Alt+ArrowDown to move focused row. after move announce polite aria-live: "Moved 'Reject risky billing' to 2 of 6" and keep focus on the moved row.

amira: validation helper should be explicit: "Condition format error 1: expected: attribute operator value (e.g., country == 'US')" + an inline monospace example and a small "See examples" expander.

sam: preview microcopy: button = "Preview 1: sample 50" and show runtime badge like "≈ 2s". batch option disabled with tooltip if est > 10s.

tess: if preview times out show: "Preview timed out 1: try sample 10 or check routing complexity" and link to troubleshooting.

amira: pinned/system rules: subtle "system" badge, hide reorder affordances, on hover show tooltip "Pinned by system policy 1: cannot reorder".

dev-bot: figma frames uploaded: https://figma.redwood/frames/xyz789 ; branch created: ui/ruleflow/compact-dock by tess. CI build 4952 started. :white_check_mark:

sam: action items: density toggle, dock collapse + persist, alt+arrow reorder, validation copy + examples, preview microcopy + runtime badge, a11y contrast fix, subtle system badge. target: staging next week if no blockers.
